children: DynaResource completed a $3.0 million private placement of 6,666,666 units at $0.45 per unit, each consisting of one common share and a warrant exercisable at $0.51. The warrants become exercisable after shareholders approve an amendment to increase authorized shares or a reverse split, and remain exercisable until the later of 180 days from issuance and 30 days after approval. To support this condition, the company secured voting agreements from key holders. Proceeds are intended to strengthen liquidity and fund corporate needs.
